text:
leila: quick sync — planning the compatibility cutover for the /generate API (v2 default -> promote v2 behavior). need owners, windows, and any blocking infra or SDK work. who can own the cutover checklist?

sam: I can own infra roll. I'll coordinate canaries and the routing toggle. timeline?

leila: thanks. target window next wed 10–12 PT for an initial canary, full cutover friday midnight PT if stable. open to moving if blockers.

ryan: runtime notes: we need a short patch to ensure older client headers still route to the v1 shim during the canary. I have a PR in review: https://git.re/redwood/runtime/pull/412

priya: ML side: model-variant fallback already set, but we need to expose the quantized fallback on the new endpoint. small change in model registry -> will ship by Tues EOD.

maria: releases: SDKs must publish a minor with compatibility flags. asking @sam for the toggle API so we can add examples. Also docs team needs deprecation warning copy.

leila: ok owners so far: sam = infra/canary, ryan = runtime shim PR, priya = model fallback, maria = SDK + docs. anyone to own post-cutover rollbacks?

sam: I can own rollback playbook; will draft a short runbook.

leila: perf targets during canary: p50 < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%. if either breaches we abort.

ryan: noted. runtime will emit a metric tag compat_cutover=canary. add alert on error_rate and latency.

maria: SDK release plan: publish JS and Python minors on Wed afternoon with a clear opt-in flag and migration snippet. example snippet:

```js
// opt-in to v2 behaviors (recommended)
const client = new Redwood({ apiVersion: 'v2', compatMode: false });
```

leila: docs-bot will you create a short migration guide and deprecation banner?

docs-bot: created draft at https://docs.re/redwood/api/migration/compat-cutover. Added deprecation banner stub. :white_check_mark:

sam: infra question — is rate limiting config changing for v2? if so we need update coordination with gateway.

priya: there is a minor token-per-request accounting change for embeddings endpoints but not /generate. confirm it's not in scope for this cutover.

leila: not in scope. keep the cutover focused. backlog the billing change.

ryan: quick note about tests — added a canary smoke that hits legacy header and new header. invocation examples in PR.

sam: deploy-bot: canary preflight?

deploy-bot: canary job queued: staging -> 2 nodes (tag: compat-canary). link: https://ci.re/job/compat-canary/557 :rocket:

maria: minor ask — we need to annotate client libraries with a clear deprecation date in the release notes. propose: deprecate v1 on 2025-01-15, migration window 6 months.

leila: okay propose that date to legal/pm. we'll lock it if no objections by EOD.

sam: action items I'll take: publish infra toggle API, draft rollback playbook, run canary and report metrics into #observability.

ryan: I'll merge the runtime PR after one more review and add the metric tags.

priya: model registry patch will be ready by Tue. I'll post the PR link here when done.

maria: I'll coordinate SDK release, add migration examples, and update release notes draft.

leila: thanks all. please ping in this thread when PRs are green and when canary metrics land. planning check-in w/eng-platform async tomorrow.

sam: noted. pinging @team to watch the canary window. :eyes:

maria: small flag — can we avoid changing client error codes during cutover? makes rollback harder.

leila: agreed. no error-code churn during this run.

deploy-bot: canary started at 1732105020, results streaming to https://metrics.re/dashboards/cutover-canary

ryan: initial canary metrics look good. p50=95ms, errors=0.2%. sharing short chart in #observability.

priya: model fallback smoke passed.

maria: SDK minor published to npm and pypi (tags: compat-preview). release notes pushed.

leila: excellent. last step: confirm docs banner, legal sign-off, and infra toggle ready. if all green we proceed with friday full cutover.

sam: toggle endpoint ready: POST /admin/toggles/compat-cutover {"state":"on","phase":"global"} 

leila: perfect. leaving final go/no-go to legal + ops but this thread tracked owners. thanks everyone.

maria: added release note deprecation date proposal to the legal thread.

leila: closing loop — if nothing else, consider this thread the single-source for cutover questions. will reopen if issues. :white_check_mark:
